title: MAGMA-Bench: Evaluating Long-Horizon Embodied Agents under Dynamic Tasks and Execution Failures
abstract: arXiv:2610.13534v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-horizon embodied agents must maintain task-relevant information, coordinate heterogeneous robots, and adapt their decisions as execution unfolds. Existing benchmarks investigate dynamic task execution and embodied multi-agent coordination, but provide limited evaluation of their intersection. We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark for persistent task reasoning in dynamic multi-robot environments. MAGMA-Bench evaluates agents across increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations, including execution failures, task interruptions, and mission updates, with scenarios requiring coordination across robots with heterogeneous capabilities. It uses a structured skill-level interface to separate task-level reasoning from perception and low-level control. translated_title: MAGMA-Bench：在动态任务与执行失败下评估长时程具身智能体
translated_abstract: 长时程具身智能体必须维持与任务相关的信息，协调异构机器人，并随着执行的推进调整其决策。现有基准研究了动态任务执行和具身多智能体协调，但对其交叉领域的评估十分有限。我们提出了MAGMA-Bench，这是一个架构无关的基准，用于评估动态多机器人环境中的持续任务推理能力。MAGMA-Bench在逐步增长的任务时间跨度和受控在线扰动（包括执行失败、任务中断和任务更新）下评估智能体，其场景需要具有异构能力的机器人之间进行协调。该基准使用结构化的技能级接口，将任务级推理与感知及低级控制相分离。我们评估了可本地部署的开源权重规划器、多智能体状态跟踪策略以及前沿模型。即使是被评估的最强模型也在……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了MAGMA-Bench——一个架构无关的基准，通过递增的任务时间跨度和受控在线扰动（如执行失败、任务中断、任务更新）评估动态多机器人环境中长时程具身智能体的持续任务推理与异构机器人协调能力，并发现即使最强的模型也难以应对这些挑战。
en_tdlr: We introduce MAGMA-Bench, an architecture-agnostic benchmark that evaluates long-horizon embodied agents in dynamic multi-robot environments through increasing task horizons and controlled online perturbations such as execution failures, interruptions, and mission updates, finding that even the strongest frontier models struggle with these challenges.
